title: fable-engine: a framework-free engine for interactive narratives with offline export and algorithmic-structure summary
description: A tiny, dependency-free TypeScript engine for interactive branching narratives. It plays stories in a Canvas 2D player, exports each story as a single self-contained offline HTML file (file over app), and deterministically summarizes the algorithmic structure of each narrative (scenes, variables, branches, modifiers) as evidence for interpreting computational thinking. Developed within the RemidiAção platform (PPGIE/UFRGS) to operationalize the remediation of written texts into interactive digital narratives.
